name: Bladegriff Prototype
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, destroy target nonland permanent of that player's choice that one of your opponents controls.
blocked_sentences: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, destroy target nonland permanent of that player's choice that one of your opponents controls.

needs.what: a target spec key naming which player chooses the target when the ability is put on the stack (here the damaged player, bound from the deals_combat_damage_to_player trigger), so the target is still a real target (hexproof/ward/shroud apply, fizzles if illegal) but picked by someone other than the ability's controller, among nonland permanents any opponent of the controller controls
needs.why_existing_wont_do: target_keys has no chooser key; targets are always declared by the ability's controller. The selector key `chooser` (as annihilator uses) picks a non-targeted object at resolution, which would drop the targeting and its hexproof/ward/fizzle consequences, so it is an approximation
